description_en: Queries attack events on Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
description_zh: 查询针对DDoS高防实例的攻击事件
name: DescribeDDoSEvents

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group in Resource Management to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs. By default, this parameter is empty, which means that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

The timestamp must be on the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

The timestamp must be on the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. For example, to query the first page, set this parameter to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询请求时返回的页码。例如，查询第一页的返回结果，则填写1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_ids

DDoSEvents.description_en: A list of DDoS attack events

Bps.description_en: The bandwidth of the attack traffic. Unit: Mbps
Bps.description_zh: 攻击流量带宽大小。单位：Mbps

EndTime.description_en: The time when the attack ended. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 攻击结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒

EventType.description_en:
The type of the attack event. Valid values:

defense: scrubbing events.

blackhole: blackhole filtering events
EventType.description_zh:
攻击事件类型。取值：
defense：清洗事件。
blackhole：黑洞事件

Pps.description_en: The packet forwarding rate of the attack traffic. Unit: pps
Pps.description_zh: 攻击流量包转发率。单位：pps

Region.description_en:
The source location of the attack. Valid values:

cn: the Chinese mainland.

alb-ap-northeast-1-gf-x: Japan.

alb-ap-southeast-gf-x: Singapore.

alb-cn-hongkong-gf-x: Hong Kong (China).

alb-eu-central-1-gf-x: Germany.

alb-us-west-1-gf-x: US (West).

Values other than cn are available only for the Anti-DDoS Premium service, for which the RegionId is ap-southeast-1
Region.description_zh:
攻击来源地区。取值：
cn：中国内地。
alb-ap-northeast-1-gf-x：日本。
alb-ap-southeast-gf-x：新加坡。
alb-cn-hongkong-gf-x：中国香港。
alb-eu-central-1-gf-x：德国。
alb-us-west-1-gf-x：美国西部。

cn以外的取值只有在DDoS高防（国际）服务（RegionId为ap-southeast-1）中提供

StartTime.description_en: The time when the attack started. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
StartTime.description_zh: 攻击开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒

Total.description_en: The total number of attack events
